name: clear_all_timeout
title: clear_all_timeout() -> undefined
description: **primitive**; cancels every timer scheduled by set_timeout that has not fired yet.

name: set_timeout
title: set_timeout(f, t) -> undefined
description: **primitive**; schedules f, a function of no arguments, to be called after t milliseconds, without blocking the calling code. An error thrown by f when it eventually runs is reported the way an uncaught runtime error normally is, not silently swallowed.
